title: A matching repair for the ordered binary matrix construction

claim: Zeroing the dummy-row × shared-leaf-column block gives a written all-depth H-free repair with m² edits. At h=1, the exact fixed-anchor optimum is four, independently certified. Unrestricted exact distance m² inherits the source lower bound.
